description: Every country in the dataset with its ISO code, slug, number of documents and the URL of its page. Returns JSON text (about 12 KB) with 'count', 'countries' and an 'attribution' line. Use find_document instead when the user already named a country.

locale.description: Language of the prose fields (title, summary, rules). One of: en, es, fr, de, pt, hi, ar, zh, ru, vi, tr, id, ja. Default 'en'. Official quotes and every number are identical in all languages.

name: list_countries
